title: Core Mechanics of Merge & Upgrade Systems
subtitle: A deep dive into merge and upgrade mechanics, breaking down merge rules, production pacing, and in-game feedback loops. The article outlines the implementation path from gameplay goals to core loops, offering reusable data structures and key numerical design principles to help developers build accessible, high-growth idle merge systems.

breakdown.title: Gameplay Goals
bullets: Enable players to continuously make 'optimal choices'
Amplify small rewards through visual feedback

breakdown.title: Core Loop
bullets: Produce resources → Merge & Upgrade → Unlock new units → Boost production

breakdown.title: Implementation Essentials
bullets: Merge table-driven: Upgrade outcomes determined by configuration
Reversible actions: Replay via event logs
Embed 'pacing' into numerical curves: Deliver strong feedback every N merges
